title: The published strict Roos product, shifted cone, and signed coordinates
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category with countable products. Use integer cochain complexes and shifts [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and strict towers [def-weil-inverse-system]. This node records the existing strictRoosProduct, strictRoosEndomorphism, strictRoosComplex, strictRoosCoordinates and strictRoosProductMap interface for the strict Roos model [def-weil-strict-roos-model]. For a cochain complex $X$ of strict towers, define $P_X=\prod_{n\in\mathbf N}X_n$ termwise, and let $u_X:P_X\to P_X$ have $n$th component $\pi_n-t_n\pi_{n+1}$ [def-weil-tower-transition-endomorphism]. Define $H_X=\operatorname{Cone}(u_X)[-1]$. Its specified degree-$(p+1)$ coordinate isomorphism $H_X^{p+1}\simeq P_X^p\oplus P_X^{p+1}$ is the canonical shift isomorphism followed by the cone biproduct isomorphism and the biproduct braiding, giving the order $(y,x)$. For a strict chain map $f:X\to Y$, define $P(f)=\prod_n f_n:P_X\to P_Y$. These are the exact published constructions in Sheaf.CategoryTheory.StrictRoosDerivedLimitComparison, with positive level $n+1$ indexed by $n\in\mathbf N$. No exactness of products, K-injective resolution, quasi-isomorphism, or derived-limit comparison theorem is part of this definition.
